name: io.github.restante/claudio-audiobook
title: claudio-audiobook
description: Make audiobooks locally with Kokoro voices from your AI assistant. Nothing leaves your computer.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIO_AUDIOBOOK_VOICE
environmentVariables.description: Default Kokoro voice, e.g. af_heart or a blend af_heart:0.6,af_sky:0.4

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIO_AUDIOBOOK_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Default format: m4b (chapters), mp3 or wav

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIO_AUDIOBOOK_AUTHOR
environmentVariables.description: Default author tag shown by audiobook players
